newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates steady on low demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates steady on low demand.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates were steady on Tuesday amid low demand by spinners and are likely to fall in the next few sessions, dealers said.

"Spinners are short of funds and are only buying their immediate requirements, which has helped keep the rates steady," dealer Kishin Chand said, adding that the prices could fall as cotton stocks were pilling up at ginning factories.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was quoted between 2,300 ($57.18) and 2,250 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) and the K-68 ranged from 2,360 to 2,225 rupees per maund, dealers said.
